title: Aromatic Korean Doraji Bowl
description: A savory and umami post-workout dish featuring bellflower root doraji, served in a stone bowl dolsot, and made halal friendly, using a molcajete vessel.
instructions: Rinse the doraji and slice it into thin strips.
Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and saute for 1 minute.
Add the sliced doraji and cook until it is tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang and soy sauce.
Pour the gochujang sauce over the cooked doraji and stir to combine.
Transfer the doraji mixture to a molcajete vessel.
Top the doraji with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
Serve the doraji over a bed of cooked rice.
Garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
